title: Asymmetric Lévy walks driven by convex combination of fractional material derivatives
summary: We analyze a class of linear partial differential equations that arise as deterministic descriptions of the scaling limits of Lévy walks, in which transport is driven by a convex combination of fractional material derivatives and a source term. Using techniques of Fourier-Laplace transforms, we first prove the existence of mild solutions for continuous initial data.
